subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy for `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`, and should `channels.feishu.streaming` remain protected from agent-side `config.patch` writes?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the fix changes Feishu's public config shape and potentially the model-to-operator config mutation boundary, so automation should not choose the product/security contract alone.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to accept and honor the shared nested preview config while preserving the current boolean default, and leave gateway mutation protection unchanged unless a separate security review approves it.

options.title: Only soften progress wording
options.body: Keep Feishu boolean-only and reduce raw/scary command wording, which is smaller but still leaves no supported way to keep streaming while hiding progress lines.

options.title: Allow coarse streaming toggle
options.body: Add `channels.feishu.streaming` to the gateway mutation allowlist so agents can disable streaming, which helps recovery but broadens an operator-controlled config path and still does not provide status-only progress.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to accept and honor the shared nested preview config while preserving the current boolean default, and leave gateway mutation protection unchanged unless a separate security review approves it.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Feishu streaming-card implementation and boolean config surface that this decision would extend.
